verdict.rationale: Box provides an extensively documented public REST API (base URL, OAuth2 auth, endpoint examples via curl) covering files, uploads, search, metadata, webhooks, events, collaborations, and AI operations, plus a developer portal with guides and changelog, and even a probed llms.txt for AI-native discovery. Missing for 10: no discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on standard paths) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
